title: Chat v2 privacy notice behavior changed to not auto agree for Eval companies
summary: Copilot chat privacy notice now requires explicit agreement for evaluation companies instead of being automatically skipped, aligning their behavior with non-evaluation companies.
key_points: Privacy notice check is no longer bypassed for evaluation companies
Evaluation companies now see the same privacy notice requirement as standard companies
Changes affect the Copilot Capability Implementation and Copilot Settings
Users in evaluation companies must now explicitly agree to privacy terms
